## Claim amendment · 2026-11-17T16:16Z

This amends the claim on PR #34914 @ `58be6ed5` (o3-C; os-dev report 6953660171).

**Surface add (A):** the PR renames Studio's "Settings → Record sharing" label. The Draft Changes publish-refusal hint `securityBlockWhere` still points the author at the old label, so this PR would make a shipped sentence false. The hint follows the new label in the same PR:
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, a value edit of the `securityBlockWhere` key only, in all 11 packs
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, the default text only

`Clause-②: no` holds (value edits). Run overlap-check against #34850's merged state and any open PR on the zh-Hans region before pushing. Mind the i18n-locale-en eager headroom, about 145 B; a value edit must not grow the en pack past it.
